candidates.change_summary: Replace construction so the EmergencyOracle is created with contract as owner (address(this)) instead of msg.sender, changing the owner of the new oracle.
Emit the event with the new oracle address as the owner parameter (newOracle) instead of msg.sender, changing the observable emitted owner value.
Insert assignment that sets jojoTeam to msg.sender before creating the oracle, changing which address is stored in jojoTeam and potentially affecting future calls and event owner semantics.
Change the onlyJojoTeam check to compare against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, altering which callers pass the modifier and thus who can create new oracles.
